source.snippet: There's documented limitations on Named Query API and using it for MCP and Agent use. However I'm trying to build a simple query with an integer parameter, while it works perfectly when called from API/workbench, it keeps failing when invoked as a tool from MCP (Custom Salesforce hosted MCP). It shows 'Unexpected error while processing request'.

problem_statement: Salesforce developers building MCP-connected agents cannot pass typed parameters (integers, dates) through Named Query API when invoked via MCP tooling, blocking agentic CRM automation workflows.
target_segment: Salesforce developers and solution architects building AI agent integrations on Salesforce platform at enterprise or mid-market companies
notes: Second Salesforce Agentforce/MCP friction signal on same day as the Flow failure issue — confirms a pattern of real paid-developer pain around Salesforce AI tooling. Buyer context: enterprise Salesforce licenses are expensive; consultant/developer time on this is billable. Opportunity: consulting playbook, integration library, or automated test harness for Agentforce/MCP parameter handling.
